By permission of God Most High: whoever carries it, his good multiplies, and
provision is made easy for him from a quarter he does not reckon on; and in it,
for companionship and for love and affection, there is what surpasses all
measure for whoever reflects upon that. And its figure comes among the figures
for the seven days, if God Most High wills.

*

Know that whoever is granted an opening into a secret of the secrets of the
mim, and into its compassing and its enfolding, and into what it contains of
worlds, witnesses the wonders of the existences. Whoever wants memorisation to
be made easy for himself, let him write this numerical secret on a Thursday,
while he is in a state of purity, facing the qiblah, and with him the name of
the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, forty times; and let him fumigate
it and drink it down with water and the honey of bees, and let him say: O God,
by the blessing of what I have drunk, make memorisation and understanding light
for me. And let him persist in that for forty days; God Most High opens his
outward and his inward. This is for the one who understands, in that he
witnesses the strength of what is in his belly of every world in the secret by
which the mim stands. With this resolve, the opening comes to be.

Whoever writes it and carries it on his right upper arm and walks among his
enemies, God Most High saves him from them and humiliates them. And whoever
enters with it upon one whose evil he fears, or upon a stubborn tyrant, is

arrogance between his hands, his soul is cut off from his own wish, and God Most
High grants him what he seeks and suffices him against his evil, because of the
wondrous secrets within it.

where the sun rises upon it and draws near, never leaving it for the whole
length of its day with its rays, will have great acceptance among all
creatures. And this is its figure:

comprehending the secrets of His names - that upon this chapter the whole of

ويخضع لك refers to creation submitting to God, not God submitting.
فلا يصف عظمتك شيء ولا حد من خلقك: do not silently repair حد to remembered أحد or invent no limit comes from creation.
يا الله تعاليت أن يكون لك شريك contains one exaltation verb, not an additional title plus a second occurrence.
ﮪ is an isolated Arabic h-like glyph, not Latin target text or a securely interpretable word.
خادم وحاسد وعين occur in the list of sun/moon entities, so retain the named designations rather than converting them into disconnected common-noun actors.
يا كبير يا متعال يا منان: متعال is the invocation Exalted One, not the added name God.
يا مؤمن is the divine title Giver of security, not one who believes.
وافعل الذي بيني وبينك الذي قال lacks a clear grammatical connector; do not invent an oath or a different speaker.
أقسمت عليك يا دردائيل is an adjuration addressed to Dardā’īl.

أقسمت عليك أيتها الأرواح addresses the spirits with an adjuration.

يذل لك جميع خلقك ويخضع لك: creation is the subject of both verbs; make the actor explicit.
فلا يصف عظمتك شيء ولا حد من خلقك: restore omitted حد wording literally without normalizing it to أحد.
يا الله تعاليت expresses exaltation once, not a title and a repeated verb.
ﮪ is an isolated h-like source glyph; keep target Latin-only and explain uncertainty.
خادم وحاسد وعين are listed entity designations in this adjuration; retain names.
عالم الأسرار means Knower, not ruler.
الملك الجبار العزيز القهار has four divine names, not three.
يا قائم يا سريع يا رقيب يا خبير contains Swift and Watchful only once each.
يا فعال لما يريد: Nia is an erroneous actor spelling.
يا مؤمن as a divine name denotes granting security, not being a believer.
عندك وسرها لديك أن means with You and their secret with You that; no differences between us or repeated request.
صلوب begins with ṣād.
وافعل الذي بيني وبينك الذي قال shifts from addressed spirit to He who said without an explicit connector; do not identify the spirit as God.
ولا حد من خلقك retains the readable word batas, rather than an omitted word or an emendation to أحد.

And these are the Most Beautiful Names of God; may God benefit by them. Among them is His name, God Most High, the Merciful, the Compassionate, and they are two majestic, mighty names, and supplication by them is beneficial for the distressed and a security for the fearful. So whoever engraves them on Friday at the end of the day in a silver ring and seals with it, then he will never see anything disliked. And whoever increases in their remembrance, he will be gently attended to in all his states. And the womb: whoever joins it, and the khawāyim, whoever cuts it, it cuts him. And as for His name, God Most High, al-Mughnī (the Enricher), whoever is frequent in His remembrance, God Most High will make him independent of all creation. And as for His name, God Most High, al-Māniʿ (the Preventer), whoever is frequent in His remembrance, God Most High will avert from him every harm; and whoever writes it upon the wall of a city or town around it one hundred and sixty-one times during the hour of Venus, God Most High will protect it from all calamities. The sages placed it upon the citadel of Mardin, so no one was able to conquer it and harm was repelled from it by the power of God Most High. And as for His name, God Most High, al-Ḍārr (the Creator of the Harmful), whoever is frequent in His remembrance and asks God Most High for the affliction of any enemy or oppressor, in the dawn of its deployment I see a wonder, by permission of God Most High. And as for His name, God Most High, al-Nāfiʿ (the Benefactor), whoever is frequent in His remembrance in a state of distress, God Most High will grant him well-being. Whoever persists in its remembrance with a sincere spiritual state until some of his spiritual realms align with him and a state from it prevails over him, he does not wipe his hand over a sick person except that God Most High cures him. Whoever places it in a silver ring upon an incised setting during the exaltation of the Moon and a sick person wears it, God Most High will cure him. Do you not see that it points to His name, God Most High, the Healer (Muʿāfī), and the names of its letters point to two majestic names that are the instruments of healing? And as for His name, God Most High, al-Nūr (the Light), whoever is frequent in His remembrance, God Most High will illuminate his heart; and if it is combined with al-Nāfiʿ, it becomes a cure for any intractable pain that defies healing; it is written and drunk as an infusion, and it has a venerable magic square (murabbaʿ), and this is its form. And as for His name, God Most High, al-Hādī (the Guide), whoever is frequent in His remembrance, light will increase in his heart and God Most High will guide his inner secrets to His gnosis (maʿrifah). And as for His name, God Most High, al-Wārith (the Supreme Inheritor), whoever is frequent in His remembrance, God Most High will grant him goodness and increase in all his movements. And as for His name, God Most High, al-Rashīd (the Infallible Guide), whoever is frequent in His remembrance, the outcomes of all his affairs will be praised. And as for His name, God Most High, al-Ṣabūr (the Patient), whoever is frequent in His remembrance, God Most High will grant him steadfastness amid hardships and crises. Maha Pengasih lagi Maha Penyayang. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi Mālik al-Mulk (Penguasa Kerajaan), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya saat ia menuntut kekuasaan, Allah Yang Mahatinggi akan menganugerahkannya kepadanya. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi Dhū al-Jalāl wa-l-Ikrām (Pemilik Keagungan dan Kemuliaan), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya lalu memohon sesuatu kepada Allah Yang Mahatinggi, Dia akan mengabulkannya. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi al-Muqsiṭ (Yang Maha Adil), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya, ia akan disifati dengan keadilan dalam seluruh keadaannya. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi al-Jāmiʿ (Yang Maha Mengumpulkan), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya, Allah akan mengembalikan kepadanya setiap barang yang hilang dan hamba yang melarikan diri. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi al-Ghanī (Yang Maha Kaya), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya, sebab-sebab kekayaan dan rezeki akan melimpah ruah kepadanya. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi al-Mughnī (Yang Maha Memberi Kekayaan), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya, Allah Yang Mahatinggi akan mencukupkannya dari ketergantungan kepada seluruh makhluk. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi al-Māniʿ (Yang Maha Mencegah), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya, Allah Yang Mahatinggi akan mencegah darinya setiap bahaya; dan barang siapa menuliskannya pada tembok kota atau negeri di sekelilingnya sebanyak seratus enam puluh satu kali pada saat Zuhrah (Venus), Allah Yang Mahatinggi akan menjaganya dari segala marabahaya. Para hukama (orang-orang bijak) telah memasangnya pada benteng Mardin, sehingga tidak seorang pun mampu menaklukkannya dan bahaya tercegah darinya dengan kekuasaan Allah Yang Mahatinggi. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi al-Ḍārr (Yang Maha Memberi Madarat), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya lalu memohon kepada Allah Yang Mahatinggi kemudaratan bagi seseorang atau orang zalim, sungguh pada fajar pengamalannya akan tampak keajaiban dengan izin Allah Yang Mahatinggi. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi an-Nāfiʿ (Yang Maha Memberi Manfaat), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya dalam keadaan tertimpa mudarat, Allah Yang Mahatinggi akan memulihkan kesehatannya. Barang siapa senantiasa melazimi mengingat-Nya disertai keadaan batin yang tulus hingga sebagian alam spiritual selaras dengannya dan keadaan tersebut menguasai dirinya, tidaklah ia mengusapkan tangannya pada orang yang sakit melainkan Allah Yang Mahatinggi akan menyembuhkannya. Dan barang siapa mengukirnya pada cincin perak bertatahkan mata cincin saat kemuliaan bulan lalu dikenakan oleh orang yang sakit, Allah Yang Mahatinggi akan menyembuhkannya. Tidakkah engkau perhatikan bahwa nama itu mengisyaratkan kepada nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi Muʿāfī (Sang Penyembuh), dan nama-nama hurufnya mengisyaratkan kepada dua nama agung yang merupakan sarana kesembuhan? Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi an-Nūr (Cahaya), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya, Allah Yang Mahatinggi akan menerangi hatinya; dan apabila digabungkan dengan an-Nāfiʿ, maka ia menjadi penawar bagi rasa sakit apa pun yang sulit disembuhkan, ditulis lalu diminum air basuhannya, serta memiliki rajah bujur sangkar (murabbaʿ) yang agung kedudukannya, dan inilah bentuknya. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi al-Hādī (Maha Pemberi Petunjuk), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya, cahaya di dalam hatinya akan semakin bertambah dan Allah Yang Mahatinggi akan membimbing rahasia batinnya menuju makrifat kepada-Nya. Dan barang siapa merasa berat atas suatu urusan dunia maupun akhirat, baik yang lahir maupun yang batin, hendaklah ia salat dua rakaat dengan membaca Āyat al-Kursī dan al-Ikhlāṣ, lalu mengulang-ulang nama itu hingga napasnya tertahan, niscaya ia akan terbimbing menuju apa yang ia tuju. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi al-Badīʿ (Pencipta yang Tiada Tara), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya, ia akan senantiasa mengalirkan pemikiran cemerlang dalam ilmu-ilmu ketuhanan dan rahasia-rahasia laduni. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi al-Wārith (Maha Mewarisi), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya, Allah Yang Mahatinggi akan mewariskan kepadanya kebaikan dan pertambahan dalam segala perbuatannya. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi ar-Rasyīd (Maha Cerdas lagi Menunjuki), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya, kesudahan seluruh urusannya akan menuai pujian. Dan adapun nama-Nya Yang Mahatinggi aṣ-Ṣabūr (Maha Penyabar), barang siapa memperbanyak mengingat-Nya, Allah Yang Mahatinggi akan memberinya keteguhan menghadapi mara bahaya dan urusan-urusan besar. Dan Allah menyatakan kebenaran dan Dia-lah yang menunjuki jalan; semoga selawat dan salam tercurah kepada junjungan kita Nabi Muḥammad, beserta keluarga dan para sahabatnya.

Ketahuilah—semoga Allah memberi taufik kepadaku dan kepadamu untuk menaati-Nya—bahwa mengenai huruf-huruf bertitik pada awal surah-surah serta huruf-huruf terputus (muqaṭṭaʿāt) keseluruhannya, dan apa yang berkaitan dengannya dari urusan-urusan pembenaran iman, sebagian ulama, semoga Allah Yang Mahatinggi meridai mereka, berkata tentang firman-Nya Yang Mahatinggi: “Alif Lām Mīm Ṣād” (al-Muṣ): maknanya adalah “Aku adalah Allah.” Al-Ḥasan berkata: “Alif adalah keazalian (al-azal), lām adalah keabadian (al-abad), sedangkan mīm dan ṣād adalah keterhubungan orang yang terhubung kepada-Nya dan keterpisahan orang yang terpisah dari-Nya.” Pada hakikatnya, tidak ada penyatuan maupun perpisahan; ungkapan-ungkapan ini berlaku menurut kebiasaan bahasa, dan barang siapa menghendaki Kebenaran sejati hendaklah memeliharanya dari sekadar lafal-lafal lahiriah. Setiap nama dari nama-nama Allah Yang Mahatinggi akan mengantarkanmu kepada suatu tingkatan derajat di antara martabat-martabat spiritual.
